newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian budget will lower 1998 PSBR - Ciampi.
newsitem.headline: Italian budget will lower 1998 PSBR - Ciampi.

text.p: The Italian mini-budget will have a knock-on affect on 1998 accounts, lowering the trend public sector borrowing requirement by some 12 trillion lire, Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said on Thursday.
Earlier, Prime Minister Romano Prodi told reporters that two-thirds of the corrective budget, approved on Thursday by the cabinet, were structural measures.
Latest government data said trend PSBR for next year would be 122.9 trillion lire and has pledged to cut this to 61 trillion lire, or three percent of gross domestic product (GDP).
Among measures to have a knock-on affect in 1998, are advance payment by companies of taxes on severance payments, which are expected to bring in some six trillion lire next year, Ciampi said.
